gloss: in any case; at any rate; either way

definitions.gloss: in any case; at any rate; whatever the case may be
definitions.explanation: Sets aside the alternatives just raised and moves to what holds regardless of them. Used to steer a discussion toward the conclusion, and common in business speech and writing.

examples.japanese: いずれにしても⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: In any case, there's no time.

examples.japanese: いずれにしても⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: At any rate, we need an answer by tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、いずれにしても⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けられない→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: Whether we raise prices has not been decided, but either way we cannot avoid explaining ourselves to customers.

notes:
USAGE:
Stands at the head of a sentence or clause, usually after two or more possibilities have been mentioned. Slightly formal but at home in ordinary polite conversation as well as in writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いずれにせよ→いずれにせよ：06779_izureniseyo⟧: in any case — the same meaning with a stiffer, more written feel
- ⟦どっちみち→どっちみち：30652_docchimichi⟧: either way — casual, spoken, and limited to two alternatives
- ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧: anyway, at any rate — brushes details aside to get to the point, more colloquial
- ⟦ともあれ→ともあれ：07337_tomoare⟧: be that as it may — literary
